items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Couldn’t be anybody but Duke Ellington and sure enough, it wasn’t anybody but Duke

ctx.x: . . . who marched to the beat of his own drum and heard, listened to his own inner voices. And whose music was uniquely – it had Duke’s personal touch [in] that you heard just a few seconds of it [and] you knew immediately that that’s Duke Ellington. Couldn’t be anybody but Duke Ellington and sure enough, it wasn’t anybody but Duke
